INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

----

   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 2.4.1 Mechanics of Writing Punctuation marks: colon, semi-colon, dash, h.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Writing 2.4.1 Mechanics of Writing Punctuation marks: colon, semi-colon, dash, h.
